# Via Arriano 11 – holiday apartment with private terrace in Pigneto, Rome

> Official website of "Via Arriano 11", a tourist apartment (alloggio per uso turistico n. 6603, CIN IT058091B4CDTSVLDV) at Via Arriano 11, 00176 Rome, Italy, in the Pigneto neighbourhood. Guests can check live availability and book directly with the owner.

## Key facts
- Type: entire apartment, up to 3 guests (double bed + sofa bed)
- Rooms: double bedroom, living room with sofa bed, equipped kitchen with coffee machine, bathroom with shower, private outdoor terrace
- Amenities: Wi‑Fi, air conditioning, projector
- Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00; usual minimum stay 3 nights
- Rome city tax: €6 per person per night, first 10 nights (included in the quote)
- Location: Pigneto (Rome, Municipio V), Metro C station a 3–5 minute walk; Colosseum with no changes, about 15 minutes door to door; tram 14 to Termini; tram 19 to Policlinico Umberto I and Sapienza University
- Direct booking: request from the website calendar, confirmed by the owner; best price promise: if the same dates are cheaper on Booking.com, the guest sends a screenshot and gets 10% off that price
- Contact: viaarriano11@gmail.com, phone/WhatsApp +39 328 675 5392
